raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

A speculative commit can contain an EOS followed by accepted draft or bonus tokens. `Req.update_finish_state` currently selects a later matched stop string or regex before checking EOS. For a verified run decoding as `k<EOS>uSTOP` with `stop=["STOP"]`, the native output path emits `ku`; sequential decoding stops at EOS and emits `k`.

## Modifications

Compare the existing token-stop boundary with the existing text-stop boundary and keep the earlier. A text stop still wins a tie, preserving stop trimming when both conditions complete at the same token. Keep the existing vocabulary, length-cap, grammar and ignored-EOS behavior. Selection among multiple literal or regex matches remains with the existing text-stop helper.

This is separate from #42466 and #42360, which select among literal stops, and #47103, which optimizes text-tail checks. Their source diffs were checked. This also preserves the earlier-text-stop behavior corrected in #28802. I directed this work and take responsibility for the contribution and its follow-up. AI assistance was used in producing the change.

## Accuracy Tests

On base 77c3bcbe2c28e1a6d1ad4121ee57231582d39bdc, two new tests and six parameterized subtests fail against unchanged production source. The fixed version passes 38 tests and 19 subtests across four related CPU files, including the real speculative resolver and detokenizer trim, reverse ordering, same-token ties, custom stop tokens, ignored EOS and length-cap controls.

    PYTHONPATH=python python -m pytest test/registered/unit/managers/test_finish_length_speculative.py test/registered/unit/managers/test_stop_str_speculative.py test/registered/unit/managers/test_grammar_stop_speculative.py test/registered/unit/managers/test_batch_result_processor_spec_grammar.py -q

Independent first-event enumeration covers 21,824 deterministic cases:2,460 mismatches on base source, zero after the fix. Tests ran with torch 2.14.1+cpu and transformers 5.19.0; source and binary import paths/hashes were verified. No model forward path, GPU kernel or weight changes; no model accuracy or GPU-serving result is claimed.

A separate local review checked the actual CPU output accumulator, batch token payload and stateful detokenizer across 20 flows, including a previously emitted prefix and pending UTF-8 bytes. This does not cover IPC, HTTP/SSE transport or a running model server.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

No speed claim. The finish check already examines both stop kinds when no text stop matches. A matched text stop now also checks token boundaries; it saves one reason/length tuple only when a token stop matches.

## Checklist

- [x] Changed-file pre-commit hooks pass, including native test CI registration validation.
- [x] Focused native CPU regressions added in the existing test file.
- [x] Public API and configuration unchanged; no documentation update required.
- [x] CPU behavioral validation and its boundaries stated above.

@@ -1467,18 +1467,20 @@ def update_finish_state(self, new_accepted_len: int = 1):
             self._cap_finished_len_at_max_new_tokens()
             return
 
-        # Stop string beats EOS/stop-token matched in the same step (speculative
-        # decoding can accept >1 token): token-based would trim only the last
-        # token and leak the stop string.
+        token_finish = None
+        if self._check_token_based_finish(new_accepted_tokens):
+            token_finish = (self.finished_reason, self.finished_len)
+
+        # A speculative run can contain both kinds of stop. Keep the earlier
+        # boundary; a text stop at the same token still wins so it is trimmed.
         if self._check_str_based_finish(new_accepted_len):
+            if token_finish is not None and token_finish[1] < self.finished_len:
+                self.finished_reason, self.finished_len = token_finish
             self._cap_finished_len_at_max_new_tokens()
             return
 
-        # Stop token/EOS beats the length cap for the same reason: a spec accept
-        # run can cross max_new_tokens in the very step the EOS lands, and a
-        # length-first finish would keep the over-accepted tokens after the EOS
-        # (up to the cap) in the emitted output.
-        if self._check_token_based_finish(new_accepted_tokens):
+        if token_finish is not None:
+            self.finished_reason, self.finished_len = token_finish
             self._cap_finished_len_at_max_new_tokens()
             return

+class TestEarlierEosSpeculative(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_eos_before_text_stop_matches_sequential_decode(self):
+        for stop_kwargs in ({"stop": ["STOP"]}, {"stop_regex": ["STOP"]}):
+            for max_new_tokens in (2, 3, 100):
+                with self.subTest(stop_kwargs=stop_kwargs, cap=max_new_tokens):
+                    tokens = [10, EOS_ID, STOP_ID]
+                    sequential = _make_req(
+                        [], max_new_tokens=max_new_tokens, **stop_kwargs
+                    )
+                    for token in tokens:
+                        sequential.output_ids.append(token)
+                        sequential.update_finish_state()
+                        if sequential.finished():
+                            break
+                    speculative = _make_req(
+                        tokens, max_new_tokens=max_new_tokens, **stop_kwargs
+                    )
+                    speculative.update_finish_state(len(tokens))
+                    self.assertEqual(
+                        speculative.finished_reason.to_json(),
+                        sequential.finished_reason.to_json(),
+                    )
+                    self.assertEqual(
+                        list(speculative.output_ids_through_stop),
+                        list(sequential.output_ids_through_stop),
+                    )
+                    self.assertEqual(speculative.finished_len, 2)
+
+    def test_spec_resolver_preserves_eos_followed_by_bonus_stop(self):
+        # A verified EOS draft can be followed by the target's bonus token.
+        # The CPU resolver keeps both when no grammar truncates the run.
+        req = _make_req([], max_new_tokens=100, stop=["STOP"])
+        processor = SchedulerBatchResultProcessor.__new__(SchedulerBatchResultProcessor)
+        object.__setattr__(
+            processor,
+            "metrics_reporter",
+            SimpleNamespace(snapshot_spec_decode_metrics=lambda *args: None),
+        )
+        object.__setattr__(
+            processor,
+            "model_worker",
+            SimpleNamespace(on_verify_complete_cpu=lambda *args, **kwargs: None),
+        )
+        result = GenerationBatchResult(
+            next_token_ids=torch.tensor([10, EOS_ID, 20, STOP_ID]),
+            accept_lens=torch.tensor([4]),
+            speculative_num_draft_tokens=4,
+        )
+        tokens = processor._resolve_spec_v2_tokens(
+            result, SimpleNamespace(reqs=[req], has_grammar=False)
+        )[0]
+        self.assertEqual(tokens, [10, EOS_ID, 20, STOP_ID])
+        req.output_ids.extend(tokens)
+        req.update_finish_state(len(tokens))
+
+        # Exercise the native final-output trim as well as the finish metadata.
+        detokenizer = DetokenizerManager.__new__(DetokenizerManager)
+        detokenizer.is_tool_call_parser_gpt_oss = False
+        detokenizer.tool_close_token_ids = set()
+        ids = detokenizer.trim_matched_stop(
+            list(req.output_ids_through_stop), req.finished_reason.to_json(), False
+        )
+        text = detokenizer.trim_matched_stop(
+            req.tokenizer.decode(ids), req.finished_reason.to_json(), False
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(text, req.tokenizer.decode([10]))
+        self.assertEqual(ids, [10])
+        self.assertIsInstance(req.finished_reason, FINISH_MATCHED_TOKEN)
+
+    def test_text_stop_before_eos_still_wins(self):
+        for stop_kwargs, reason in (
+            ({"stop": ["STOP"]}, FINISH_MATCHED_STR),
+            ({"stop_regex": ["STOP"]}, FINISHED_MATCHED_REGEX),
+        ):
+            with self.subTest(stop_kwargs=stop_kwargs):
+                req = _make_req(
+                    [10, STOP_ID, EOS_ID], max_new_tokens=100, **stop_kwargs
+                )
+                req.update_finish_state(3)
+                self.assertIsInstance(req.finished_reason, reason)
+                self.assertEqual(req.finished_len, 2)
+
+    def test_earlier_custom_stop_token_beats_text_stop(self):
+        req = _make_req(
+            [10, EOS_ID, STOP_ID],
+            max_new_tokens=100,
+            stop=["STOP"],
+            eos_token_ids=frozenset(),
+        )
+        req.sampling_params.stop_token_ids = {EOS_ID}
+        req.update_finish_state(3)
+        self.assertIsInstance(req.finished_reason, FINISH_MATCHED_TOKEN)
+        self.assertEqual(req.finished_len, 2)
+
+    def test_text_stop_wins_at_same_token_as_eos(self):
+        req = _make_req(
+            [10, STOP_ID],
+            max_new_tokens=100,
+            stop=["STOP"],
+            eos_token_ids={STOP_ID},
+        )
+        req.update_finish_state(2)
+        self.assertIsInstance(req.finished_reason, FINISH_MATCHED_STR)
+        self.assertEqual(req.finished_len, 2)
+
+    def test_ignored_eos_does_not_beat_text_stop(self):
+        req = _make_req([10, EOS_ID, STOP_ID], max_new_tokens=100, stop=["STOP"])
+        req.sampling_params.ignore_eos = True
+        req.update_finish_state(3)
+        self.assertIsInstance(req.finished_reason, FINISH_MATCHED_STR)
+        self.assertEqual(req.finished_len, 3)
+
+
